parameters.question: Compare classification reports (per-class precision, recall, F1) from a 1D CNN ECG normal vs. arrhythmic classifier; values must match within +/-0.10; row and column order may differ.

Compare CNN performance metrics for ECG normal vs. arrhythmic classification (1D CNN, 256 time points, 70/30 split, 50 epochs, batch size 32). Accuracy values must match within +/-0.10; row and column order may differ.

Compare 2x2 confusion matrices (normal vs. arrhythmic) from a 1D CNN ECG classifier with a 70/30 train-test split. Convert each cell count to a proportion of total test samples; each proportion must be within +/-0.10 of the reference proportion. Class label naming (e.g., 0/1 vs normal/arrhythmic) and row/column order may differ, so align cells by semantic class meaning.
